title: Deals | Selecting a stage on a deal either fails with "Validation failed" or applies the stage but switches the deal to the default pipeline
env: staging-crm.taviportal.com · tenant NDC-Staging · Edge (headless) · account mahmoud.mahamed1515 (CRM Admin); test user 1 / test user 2 where noted

panels.caption: Create Transactions, pipeline "1" picked: the Stage list offers the 7 stages of "1" (test-01 … identify_decision_makers).
Save → POST 422; the form shows the raw message with the pipeline id under Pipeline "1".
Shared staging blocker card: the Deals Pipeline pick-list field allows only "Standard (Standard)", so every deal write that sends a pipeline — "1" or even the default Standard — is refused with 422.

rows: Stages offered = the chosen pipeline's stages
Pipeline "1" → its 7 stages offered (test-01, test-02, qualification, needs_analysis, negotiation, proposal, identify_decision_makers)
Save → POST 422 "Pipeline: '640e03a4-…' is not one of the allowed values (Standard (Standard))." shown with the raw pipeline id
API create on "1"/test-01 and PATCH an existing deal to "1"
Both 422 PICKLIST_VALUE_INVALID; deal stays on Standard (21 Oct: 201 + silent switch to Standard)
Staging Deals Pipeline field allows only "Standard (Standard)" (changed 24 Oct by ndc-staging-owner); even the default Standard is refused, so the fix cannot be judged until the field is repaired
